pack.name: Uganda MoWT Road Design Manual (2010)
pack.publisher: Ministry of Works and Transport, Republic of Uganda
pack.read_by: automated reader working from the text of a third-party hosted copy of Volume 1 (Geometric Design); table layouts were jumbled in places and were reassembled and cross-checked by arithmetic and between tables. The Ministry's own copy was not available.
pack.review_status: NOT REVIEWED by an engineer. Values must be checked against the Ministry's printed copy of the manual before the product relies on them.
pack.uganda_caveat: This is the primary basis for Ugandan work. UK DMRB, SATCC, AASHTO and TRL values are secondary references for items this manual does not cover.

licence.name: Government of Uganda publication; licence not stated in the copy read
licence.printed_notice: Ministry of Works and Transport, Road Design Manual, Volume 1: Geometric Design Manual, January 2010.
licence.attribution: Contains values from the Uganda Ministry of Works and Transport Road Design Manual, Volume 1: Geometric Design Manual (2010). Confirm reuse terms with the Ministry.

entries.condition: DV-4 and DV-5 only; the table prints 6.1 & 9.1 for DV-4 and 6.1 & 12.8 for DV-5
entries.note: Reading of the second figure as the trailer wheelbase is the AfroBIM reading of '6.1 & 9.1'; it is supported by the overall length sum. entries.title: Design vehicle types
entries.text: DV-1: 4x4 passenger car; DV-2: single unit truck; DV-3: single unit bus; DV-4: semitrailer combination; DV-5: large (interstate) semitrailer
entries.note: The table header lists the five types in this order; the copy read has the types in a header line, not beside each row, so the pairing follows the order and the dimensions (a 5.8 m car, 9.1 m truck, 12.1 m bus). Read from a third-party hosted copy of the manual; verify against the Ministry's printed copy. Overall length equals front overhang plus wheelbase(s) plus rear overhang for every vehicle.
entries.source: Uganda MoWT Road Design Manual, Volume 1: Geometric Design Manual (January 2010), Section 5.1, Table 5-1: Dimensions of Design Vehicle, p49
